name: kernel-names-2-armor-accessory
description: #260 part 1 Tier 2: the armor and accessory name tables in disc 1's INIT/KERNEL.BIN (sections from semantic/game-text.js KERNEL_NAME_SECTIONS), read inside the run by runner/kernel-names.js. Input: one frame from the title boot point (the check reads the disc, not the run). <kind>_ok: the table builds, no entry fails to decode, and the entry count is 1 to the kind's ID count (NAME_KIND_COUNTS). <kind>_n, <kind>_empty, <kind>_bad: entries, empty entries and entries that fail to decode. Only numbers leave; no name, string or byte.
